g_rules.text: First use: optionally open with 1-2 sentences on what the skill covers; subsequent use go straight to output
Standard post limit 280 characters
Premium accounts allow up to 25,000 characters
URLs count as 23 characters (t.co)
Emoji count as ~2 characters each
General posts 71-100 characters for best engagement
Promotional posts 120-130 characters
Question posts 60-80 characters
Retweet-friendly posts ~116 characters
Threads are 3-5 connected posts
Number thread posts as 1/5, 2/5, etc.
First post is a strong hook; never say 'thread' in the first line
Last thread post is a CTA, summary, or question
Each thread post ~80 chars and can stand alone
Hook = first 1-2 lines (~10%), question/fact/emotion, ~50 chars
Value section (~70%) carries practical info; use a thread for depth
CTA section (~20%) calls for a reply, question, or action
End with an open question to drive replies
Favor open questions, controversial views, stories; avoid 'RT if agree' bait
Put external links in a reply, not the main post (link penalty ~50%)
Max 1 link per 5 posts
Link preview: title <=70 chars, description <=200 chars, 1200x628 image
Video posts: 8-30s short video preferred
Content mix 70% value / 20% interaction / 10% promo
Single image spec 1200x675 (16:9)
Other image specs: square 800x800, profile 400x400, header 1500x500
Image file ~5MB, JPG/PNG
Output post text with character count
Output hashtags if used; 1-3 recommended
Output thread structure when it is a thread
Output image specs when a design agent needs dimensions
Early interaction (first 30 min) and author reply chains drive reach
Bookmarks/saves boost recommendation
Media (images/video) boost exposure ~2x
